title: Episode 05 — Naama Freedman
subtitle: Naama Freedman
synopsis: Naama Freedman is an Israeli artist, musician, performer and DJ based in Hamburg, working across video, film, installation and performance — often weaving historical reference and spoken text into questions of intimacy, control and violence.

During her residency she developed a radio-art piece, “Little Miss Freedman’s Variety Show,” blending storytelling, poetry and live music into an aural journey through the history and character of Brussels’ Marolles neighbourhood.
